scope: Every public dmSDK declaration whose presence, or whose type, depends on the Defold bundle target being built. A declaration absent from this census is target-invariant: no platform conditional decides whether it exists and none decides any name its type mentions.
derivation: a target's macro assignment is Defold's own build_input.yml defines over the declared toolchain and architecture predefines
a branch is target-varying when the targets do not agree about taking it
a declaration inside a target-varying branch is present only for the targets that take it
a declaration outside every such branch is target-conditional when its type names something a branch introduces
a macro the assignment does not decide leaves its branch unresolved for that target, never absent

buildVariants.note: Every target is resolved once per build variant and the three are required to agree; a header conditional that disagreed would fail this pass rather than be averaged away. `NDEBUG` and `DM_PROFILE_NULL` - the two macros dmsdk/dlib/profile.h gates its entire API on - are defined by no variant, so an extension is compiled against the full profiler API in all three. The debug/release difference is which archive is linked, and that is measured in the symbol evidence.
